response.overview: Early morning in Verbier, Switzerland: Former Freeride World Tour winner Emilien Badoux meets his longtime friend Géraldine Fasnacht and their protégé Liam Rivera for a very special splitboard tour. Their destination: the Bec des Rosses (3,223 m), the mountain that symbolically – and literally – represents the pinnacle of the Freeride World Tour.
